The credentials saved for ${provider} were not accepted. Fix them in Settings or switch provider, then send your message again.

zh_translation: 额度很快就会重置。用 Nous 账户登录可获得更大额度，免费。

english: You've used up the allowance for chatting without signing in
zh_translation: 免登录对话的额度已用完

zh_translation: 用 Nous 账户登录是免费的。

zh_translation: 用 Nous 账户登录（免费），或检查 NOUS_INFERENCE_BASE_URL 设置。

zh_translation: Hermes 无法在此线路上连到免费模型

zh_translation: 回复反复重复同样的步骤，Hermes 已中止。请重试；若再次发生，请新建对话。

${provider} does not offer this model on your account. Choose another model, then send your message again.
zh_translation: ${provider} 在你的账户上不提供该模型。请换一个模型后重新发送。

zh_translation: Hermes 结束本轮时没有回复。请重试以重新发送。

zh_translation: 请求超出模型容量。请压缩对话或新建对话，然后重新发送。

english: The connection dropped before the reply finished. Retry to send it again.
zh_translation: 回复完成前连接中断。请重试以重新发送。

english: The model stopped before finishing. Retry to get a complete reply.
zh_translation: 模型未完成就停止了。请重试以获得完整回复。

english: A firewall or CDN in front of ${provider} blocked the request before it reached the model — your key is probably fine. Set a User-Agent header via the provider's extra_headers in Settings, or switch provider, then send your message again.
zh_translation: ${provider} 前面的防火墙或 CDN 在请求到达模型前将其拦截——你的密钥多半没问题。请在设置中通过该提供方的 extra_headers 设置 User-Agent 头，或切换提供方，然后重新发送。

english: The AI service rejected your sign-in. Check the credentials for this provider, then send your message again.
zh_translation: AI 服务拒绝了你的登录。请检查该提供方的凭据，然后重新发送。

english: Your account has no credits left for this provider. Top up or switch provider, then send again.

zh_translation: 磁盘已满，Hermes 无法保存这段对话。请清理空间后重试。

english: Hermes hit an internal problem starting this reply. Send your message again; if it keeps happening, send diagnostics.
zh_translation: Hermes 在开始这次回复时遇到内部问题。请重新发送；若持续出现，请发送诊断信息。

english: Hermes hit an internal problem starting this reply. Send your message again; if it keeps happening, send diagnostics.
zh_translation: Hermes 在开始这次回复时遇到内部问题。请重新发送；若持续出现，请发送诊断信息。

zh_translation: 无法打开 Hermes 文件夹

english: Sign in with a Nous account

zh_translation: 磁盘已满，Hermes 无法启动。

english: Hermes' background service stopped right after starting.
zh_translation: Hermes 的后台服务刚启动就停止了。

english: Part of Hermes' installation is missing. Choose Repair install to put it back.
zh_translation: Hermes 安装不完整。请选择“修复安装”补回。

english: Hermes couldn't write to its data folder (permission problem).
zh_translation: Hermes 无法写入其数据文件夹（权限问题）。

english: Another program is using the network port Hermes needs.
zh_translation: 另一个程序占用了 Hermes 需要的网络端口。

english: Hermes' background service didn't answer in time.
zh_translation: Hermes 的后台服务未及时响应。

english: Sign in again to reconnect. Your chats and settings are safe.
zh_translation: 请重新登录以恢复连接。你的对话和设置安然无恙。

english: The leftover update process may still be changing Hermes' files. Starting now can load a half-updated install, which may not work until you run the update again. Hermes records this choice in its log and leaves the update marker in place.
zh_translation: 遗留的更新进程可能仍在改动 Hermes 的文件。现在启动可能载入更新到一半的安装，再次运行更新前可能无法正常工作。Hermes 会把这次选择记入日志，并保留更新标记。

english: Start Hermes while the update still holds it?
zh_translation: 更新仍占用 Hermes 时仍要启动吗？

english: Hermes is holding off on starting so it can't load files an update may still be changing. It starts by itself as soon as the hold ends.
zh_translation: Hermes 暂缓启动，以免载入更新可能仍在改动的文件。占用一结束它就会自行启动。

english: The update (process ${pid}) exited, but a process it started still holds the Hermes install.
zh_translation: 更新（进程 ${pid}）已退出，但它启动的某个进程仍占用 Hermes 安装。

english: An update exited, but a process it started still holds the Hermes install.
zh_translation: 更新已退出，但它启动的某个进程仍占用 Hermes 安装。

english: This usually clears in a few minutes. If it does not: quit Hermes, end leftover git or hermes processes (or restart the computer), then open Hermes again.
zh_translation: 通常几分钟内就会解除。若没有：退出 Hermes，结束遗留的 git 或 hermes 进程（或重启电脑），然后再次打开 Hermes。

english: What holds the install changed before Hermes could start. Review it and try again.
zh_translation: 占用安装的对象在 Hermes 启动前发生了变化。请查看后重试。

english: An earlier update still holds Hermes
zh_translation: 先前的更新仍在占用 Hermes

english: Hermes can't confirm the last update finished
zh_translation: Hermes 无法确认上次更新已完成

english: The update helper couldn't check who owns the Hermes install right now. Hermes keeps checking.
zh_translation: 更新助手目前无法确认谁占用了 Hermes 安装。Hermes 会持续检查。

zh_translation: 小写字母、数字和连字符，最多 32 个。例如 work 或 home。

zh_translation: 请使用小写字母、数字和连字符，并以字母或数字开头。

zh_translation: Hermes 将不再以该账户身份操作。你的其他账户保持连接。

english: Managed apps are not available for this account yet.

zh_translation: 登录 Nous 即可使用托管应用。

zh_translation: 在此应用中创建或更改内容。

会访问此应用之外的内容。

zh_translation: 此文件不存在——可能已被删除或移动，也可能位于另一台机器上。

english: That path is not on this computer — it lives on the backend machine. Use “Reveal in filetree”.
zh_translation: 该路径不在这台电脑上——它位于后端机器上。请改用“在文件树中显示”。

english: This version of Hermes can't start without a Nous account. Sign in or create one, it's free and only takes a minute.
zh_translation: 此版本的 Hermes 没有 Nous 账户就无法启动。请登录或注册一个，免费且只需一分钟。

english: Hermes couldn't set up free access without signing in. Signing in is free, or connect another provider.
zh_translation: Hermes 未登录就无法设置免费访问。登录是免费的，也可连接其他提供方。

english: This session can't continue without signing in. Sign in or create a free Nous account to keep going.
zh_translation: 此会话不登录就无法继续。请登录或注册一个免费的 Nous 账户以继续。

english: Using Hermes without signing in is paused for a moment. Hermes will keep checking. Signing in is free and gets you going right now.
zh_translation: 免登录使用 Hermes 已暂时暂停。Hermes 会持续检查。登录免费，且能立刻让你用起来。

english: The Nous server asked for a proof of work, but that isn't implemented in your Agent yet. Sign in or create a free Nous account to continue.
zh_translation: Nous 服务器要求工作量证明，但你的 Agent 尚未实现该功能。请登录或注册一个免费的 Nous 账户以继续。

english: Lots of people are getting started right now, so Hermes will try again in ${wait}. Signing in is free and skips the wait.
zh_translation: 现在有很多人正在开始使用，Hermes 将在 ${wait} 后重试。登录免费，还能免去等待。

english: The Nous service had a hiccup. Tap Try again in a moment, or connect another provider for now.
zh_translation: Nous 服务出了点小问题。请稍后点“重试”，或暂时连接其他提供方。

english: Signing in is free. Pick Nous below.
zh_translation: 登录是免费的。请在下方选择 Nous。

zh_translation: Hermes 无法连到 Nous 服务。请检查网络连接，然后点“重试”；也可以暂时连接其他提供方。

english: Hermes couldn't reach the Nous service to finish signing you in. Check your internet connection and try again. Your session is still here.

zh_translation: 请再试“重启”；若仍失败，请打开日志并发送诊断信息。

english: The app and the backend are on different versions. Update both.
zh_translation: 应用与后端版本不一致。请一并更新。

english: Hermes couldn't save to its data folder. Open Maintenance to check and repair it.
zh_translation: Hermes 无法写入其数据文件夹。请打开“维护”检查并修复。

english: Sign-in with ${provider} did not finish. Check your internet connection and try again, or pick a different provider.
zh_translation: 使用 ${provider} 登录未完成。请检查网络连接后重试，或换一个提供方。

english: That path does not exist on this computer
zh_translation: 该路径在这台电脑上不存在

english: Controls how image attachments are sent to the model.
zh_translation: 控制图片附件如何发送给模型。

english: Upper bound for tool-calling turns before Hermes stops a run.
zh_translation: Hermes 一次运行中工具调用轮次的上限。

zh_translation: Hermes 如何处理需要明确审批的命令。

english: How long approval prompts wait before timing out.
zh_translation: 审批提示等待多久后超时。

english: Seconds to wait for the auxiliary compression model per call (default 120). Raise for slow local models.
zh_translation: 每次调用辅助压缩模型等待的秒数（默认 120）。本地模型较慢时可调高。

english: Local browsing uses your real logins. Hermes copies your default browser's profile (cookies, logins, preferences) into a managed snapshot and drives it with its packaged Chromium — your live profile is never opened directly, and the copy is refreshed from it on each run. Also lets the agent open a local real-profile session on request even when a cloud browser backend is configured. Only Chromium browsers (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Brave Origin, Chromium) are supported; a non-Chromium default fails with a clear message. Off by default.
zh_translation: 本地浏览会使用你真实的登录信息。Hermes 会把默认浏览器的配置（Cookie、登录信息、偏好）复制到一份受管快照中，并用自带的 Chromium 驱动它——你的实时配置从不被直接打开，且每次运行都会从它刷新该副本。开启后，即便配置了云端浏览器后端，也允许智能体按需打开一个使用本地真实配置的会话。仅支持 Chromium 系浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Brave Origin、Chromium）；默认浏览器不是 Chromium 系时会给出明确报错。默认关闭。

english: Create rollback snapshots before file edits.
zh_translation: 在编辑文件前创建可回滚的快照。

english: How strictly code execution is scoped to the current project.
zh_translation: 代码执行被限定在当前项目内的严格程度。

english: Raise compression to 85% for supported ChatGPT Codex OAuth models.
zh_translation: 对受支持的 ChatGPT Codex OAuth 模型将压缩阈值提高到 85%。

english: Summarize older context when conversations get large.
zh_translation: 对话变大时对较早的上下文做摘要。

english: Strategy for managing long conversations near the context limit.
zh_translation: 接近上下文上限时管理长对话的策略。

english: Scan local folders for Git repositories to show in Projects.
zh_translation: 扫描本地文件夹中的 Git 仓库，在项目页中显示。

english: Folders and their descendants to skip during repository discovery.
zh_translation: 在仓库发现过程中跳过的文件夹及其子目录。

english: Folders to scan. Leave empty to scan your home directory.
zh_translation: 要扫描的文件夹。留空则扫描你的主目录。

english: Default assistant style for new sessions.
zh_translation: 新会话默认的助手风格。

english: Show reasoning sections when the backend provides them.
zh_translation: 后端提供推理内容时显示推理区块。

english: Backup provider:model entries to try if the default model fails.
zh_translation: 默认模型失败时尝试的备用 provider:model 条目。

english: Maximum characters Hermes can read from one file request.
zh_translation: 单次文件读取请求中 Hermes 最多可读取的字符数。

english: Save durable memories that can help future sessions.
zh_translation: 保存有助于未来会话的持久记忆。

english: Maintain a compact profile of user preferences.
zh_translation: 维护一份精简的用户偏好档案。

english: Used for new chats unless you pick a different model in the composer.
zh_translation: 用于新对话，除非你在输入框中选择其他模型。

english: Overrides the detected context window of the MAIN chat model only (tokens). Leave at 0 to use the selected model's detected value. Does not affect auxiliary/MoA models.
zh_translation: 仅覆盖主对话模型检测到的上下文窗口（token）。留 0 则使用所选模型检测到的值。不影响辅助/MoA 模型。

english: Hide detected secrets from model-visible content when possible.
zh_translation: 尽可能把检测到的密钥从模型可见内容中隐去。

english: Post the raw 🎙️ transcript of voice messages back to the chat.
zh_translation: 把语音消息的原始 🎙️ 转写文本回传到对话中。

english: Optional ISO-639-3 language code. Blank lets ElevenLabs auto-detect.
zh_translation: 可选的 ISO-639-3 语言代码。留空则由 ElevenLabs 自动检测。

english: Enable local or provider-backed speech transcription.
zh_translation: 启用本地或提供方支持的语音转写。

english: Show text while you speak (OpenAI, xAI, ElevenLabs). Falls back to the recording on any failure.
zh_translation: 在你说话时实时显示文字（OpenAI、xAI、ElevenLabs）。任何失败都会回退到录音。

english: Default project folder for tool and terminal work.
zh_translation: 工具与终端工作时默认使用的项目文件夹。

english: Image used when the execution backend is Daytona.
zh_translation: 执行后端为 Daytona 时使用的镜像。

english: Container image used when the execution backend is Docker.
zh_translation: 执行后端为 Docker 时使用的容器镜像。

english: Environment variables to pass into tool execution.
zh_translation: 传入工具执行的环境变量。

english: Image used when the execution backend is Modal.
zh_translation: 执行后端为 Modal 时使用的镜像。

english: SSH backend: keep exported variables between commands. Off starts each command from the login environment; the working directory always carries over.
zh_translation: SSH 后端：在命令之间保留已导出的变量。关闭则每条命令都从登录环境开始；工作目录始终延续。

english: Image used when the execution backend is Singularity.
zh_translation: 执行后端为 Singularity 时使用的镜像。

english: IANA timezone identifier. Blank uses the system timezone.
zh_translation: IANA 时区标识符。留空则使用系统时区。

english: Let an LLM insert expressive audio tags ([laughing], [sighs]) into the script before synthesis.
zh_translation: 让 LLM 在合成前把富有表现力的音频标签（[laughing]、[sighs]）插入脚本。

english: MP3 bitrate in bps. Only applies when codec is mp3.
zh_translation: MP3 比特率，单位 bps。仅当编码为 mp3 时生效。

english: Spoken language code (e.g. en, pt-BR) or "auto" for auto-detection.
zh_translation: 朗读语言代码（如 en、pt-BR），或填 "auto" 自动检测。

english: Latency vs. quality trade-off. 0 = best quality, 2 = lowest latency.
zh_translation: 延迟与音质的权衡。0 = 最佳音质，2 = 最低延迟。

english: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger files.
zh_translation: 音频采样率，单位 Hz。越高音质越好、文件越大。

english: xAI voice ID (e.g. eve) or a custom voice ID.
zh_translation: xAI 语音 ID（如 eve）或自定义语音 ID。

english: When Hermes updates itself from the app (no terminal prompt), keep local source edits (stash) or throw them away (discard). Terminal updates always ask.
zh_translation: Hermes 从应用内更新自己时（无终端提示），保留本地源码改动（暂存）还是丢弃（discard）。终端更新始终会询问。

english: Extra sentences for the live voice persona (tone, pace, language). Hermes keeps its own system prompt.
zh_translation: 实时语音人设的补充说明（语气、语速、语言）。Hermes 保留自己的系统提示词。

english: Voice for GPT-Live mode. Custom voice IDs are accepted.
zh_translation: GPT-Live 模式使用的语音。支持自定义语音 ID。

english: chained: speech-to-text → Hermes → text-to-speech with the providers below. gpt-live: one full-duplex OpenAI voice model (gpt-live-1) listens and talks, and hands every real request to Hermes — any model you have selected answers with the full toolset. Needs an OpenAI API key; the voice layer bills $0.05 per minute.
zh_translation: chained：语音转文字 → Hermes → 文字转语音，使用下方提供方。gpt-live：一个全双工的 OpenAI 语音模型（gpt-live-1）负责听和说，并把每个真实请求交给 Hermes——你选定的任何模型都会带着完整工具集作答。需要 OpenAI API 密钥；语音层按每分钟 $0.05 计费。
私有网址使用本地浏览器
使用我真实的浏览器配置
主模型上下文窗口（覆盖）
应用内更新的本地改动

english: Terminal commands now run locally. Applies to new sessions.
zh_translation: 终端命令现在在本地运行。对新会话生效。

english: Hermes can't run shell commands right now: ${backend} isn't ready. Switch to Local, or finish setting up ${backend} and try again.
zh_translation: Hermes 现在无法运行 shell 命令：${backend} 尚未就绪。请切换到“本地”，或完成 ${backend} 的设置后重试。

english: Your config, chats, and secrets live in ${path}. Removing the app does not delete them.
zh_translation: 你的配置、对话和密钥存放在 ${path}。卸载应用不会删除它们。

english: This install is managed by your system, so Hermes cannot remove itself.
zh_translation: 此安装由你的系统管理，因此 Hermes 无法自行卸载。

english: Quit Hermes on this profile, then inspect the file without changing it, or restore a snapshot:
zh_translation: 先在此配置下退出 Hermes，然后在不改动文件的情况下查看它，或恢复某个快照：

english: Hermes can't read all of the session history for ${profiles}. Chats missing from this list were not deleted; the file they are stored in is damaged.
zh_translation: Hermes 无法完整读取 ${profiles} 的会话历史。此列表中缺失的对话并未被删除；存储它们的文件已损坏。

english: The security scan flagged ${findings > 0 ? `${findings} item${findings === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'risky patterns'} to review${unverified ? ' and the skill comes from an unverified source' : ''}. Read the scan before deciding whether to trust the author.
zh_translation: 安全扫描标记了待复核的 ${findings > 0 ? `${findings} 项` : '风险模式'}${unverified ? '，且该技能来自未经验证的来源' : ''}。请在决定是否信任作者之前先阅读扫描结果。

english: Stored in the profile's .env as ${env}, never in config.yaml; leave blank to keep the current value.
zh_translation: 存放在配置的 .env 中（名为 ${env}），绝不写入 config.yaml；留空则保持当前值。
已为 ${profile} 禁用 ${name} 智能体工具
已为 ${profile} 启用 ${name} 智能体工具

english: Could not toggle the ${name} agent tools; the Desktop panel was left unchanged
zh_translation: 无法切换 ${name} 智能体工具；桌面面板保持不变

english: The new catalog pin of ${name} (${sha}) adds surfaces the installed version does not have. Apply it only if you trust them:
zh_translation: ${name} 的新目录固定版本（${sha}）增加了已安装版本没有的界面。仅在你信任它们时才应用：

english: Backend updated, but still owed: ${steps}. Re-run `hermes update` to finish them.
zh_translation: 后端已更新，但仍欠：${steps}。重新运行 `hermes update` 以完成它们。
